newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Argentine cash wheat rises on rain damage.
newsitem.headline: Argentine cash wheat rises on rain damage.

text.p: Argentine cash wheat firmed again in tight cash market trade at the Buenos Aires Cereals Exchange, after the government confirmed rain damage to the 1996/97 crop, traders said.

Spot prices jumped by $7 in Bahia Blanca and Quequen to $135, farmer prices. The government said Tuesday that at least 200,000 hectares had been destroyed and there was quality damage to another 700,000 to 1.0 million tonnes. Maize and sunflowe seed prices were mainly steady in slow trade. Cash soybeans firmed in obedience to a firmer Chicago, but cash volume was low.
